messages:
Riley (Design): quick pass request — NovaGrid sent the marketplace hero + case tile. Need a quick check for brand lockup, small-size legibility, WCAG contrast, and alt text. Files here: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/nova-creative and https://s3.redwood-inference.com/partners/novagrid/hero_v3.png. Can someone take?

Samir K: I can take logo spacing + small-size legibility. FYI their SVG contains an embedded raster gradient which might rasterize on some browsers. Will test at 48px and 24px and report back by EOD.

Maria P: Also flagging a copy issue — partner included a customer quote that mentions a competitor by name. @LegalBot can you advise if we should redact or get written signoff before publishing?

LegalBot: Flag: need confirm that partner has a signed release for the customer quote and permission for co-branded use. If the quote explicitly names a competitor, recommend replacing with neutral phrasing (e.g., 'a leading provider') unless we have explicit written consent. Please attach the partner's permissions doc.

Elena G: Quick findings from initial check: CTA overlay fails contrast (measured 2.8:1). WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for body text. Suggest darken overlay color or add subtle text stroke. Alt text examples: 'NovaGrid + Redwood Inference integration dashboard showing latency and throughput charts' and short thumbnail alt: 'NovaGrid integration — latency chart'.

Riley (Design): good call. Samir, can you include 48px and 24px renders in your pass? Also update alt text per Elena's suggestion.

Samir K: Uploaded preview renders: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/partners/novagrid/logo_48.png and https://s3.redwood-inference.com/partners/novagrid/logo_24.png. 24px loses the diamond mark — recommend using logotype-only at <=24px. Also the marketplace thumbnail crop currently cuts off the quote attribution — suggest moving the quote up or shortening it.

Maria P: For the marketplace listing NovaGrid requested a 'powered by NovaGrid' badge. Our brand guidelines require co-badging at min width 72px. @Riley (Design) pls ensure badge meets min size and clearspace rules.

Riley (Design): will produce updated hero with stronger overlay, adjusted crop, and badge at 72px min width. ETA: tomorrow 10:00 PT.

LegalBot: Also confirm trademark usage per partner guide. They attached a permissions PDF in the onboarding packet (see: onboarding/novagrid/trademark_license.pdf). If anyone doesn't have access, ping me and I will share.

Elena G: quick accessibility checklist for the PR: alt text present, keyboard-focus order tested on carousel, captions for any autoplay video, contrast >=4.5:1 for body text, and image captions for complex charts. I'll add this checklist to the PR template.

Samir K: after Riley updates, I'll push final assets to S3 under partners/novagrid/final/ and update the marketplace listing draft. Will notify when done.

Riley (Design): Awesome — action items consolidated: 1) Samir: update renders + upload final assets (include 48px/24px guidance). 2) Elena: add accessibility checklist to PR. 3) Maria: confirm quote release or request neutral phrasing. 4) LegalBot: confirm trademark/license permission. I'll deliver updated hero + badge by tomorrow 10:00 PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
